phase.objective: Prove the canonical Ubuntu profile, artifacts, NoCloud bootstrap, and key-only loopback SSH path in the host-QEMU lab before adding guest mesh behavior.
entryCriteria: The final F01 head passed the complete static, Android, guest, packaging, signature, and alignment workflow.
The host-QEMU lab consumes the same checked-in profile and locked artifact identities packaged for Android.
This phase makes no Android or physical-device acceptance claim.
exitCriteria: One command prepares, boots, verifies, records, and cleans up the canonical Ubuntu host-QEMU lab.
Real QMP running state, NoCloud completion, and key-only SSH through loopback SLIRP are proven.
Clean guest and QEMU restart behavior is recorded without introducing Headscale or guest-mesh scope.
Bounded machine-readable evidence records exact artifact identities and finds no retained one-use bootstrap credentials.
